title: 2 BR Condo Gym! Perfect Summer Spot!
description:
Welcome to Pine Street Flats! Our 2 bedroom condo is situated on the 2nd floor of our building, right in the heart of the Gulch neighborhood in downtown Nashville.

• Walkable to restaurants, coffee shops, & shopping
• 1 mile from HONKY TONK ROW!
• Saltwater Swimming Pool 
• Gym
• Free WiFi & Smart TV 
• Secure & Covered Paid Parking available for $40/day with in and out privileges
• Full Kitchen
• Queen sofa bed!

Perfect location to explore Music City!

PERMIT# Listed in Pictures

The space
You won't be disappointed as you walk to your home away from home.  Modern, open floor plan, high ceilings and walk-in closets- perfect place to call home for the weekend! The unit has comfortable queen-sized beds in the bedrooms and a couch that folds down to become a small bed (note that this is full; it can sleep two people, but it is very small. Cots are available to rent for a $25 fee). 

Unit Amenities:

Full access to building gym, lounge and saltwater pool open year round! 
Fully equipped kitchen
Free WIFI and Smart TV (with Digital Antenna)
Microwave
Coffee/Espresso maker in the club room lounge 
Air Conditioning
Hair Dryer
Linens for additional guests
All bathroom essentials (towels, shampoo, etc...)
Pictures are of a similar unit in the building.

Guest access
You'll have full access to the entire unit during your stay, as well as the year-round salt water pool and full gym. 

Parking: Paid parking is available onsite. We can provide ONE parking pass for the residential section of the garage for $40/day. Residential parking guarantees one parking spot with in-and-out privileges. The second option is to park in the public section of the garage which typically starts at $40/day however WITHOUT in-and-out privileges and no guaranteed spot. *No in -and-out privileges means if you leave the parking garage and return, you will need to restart your parking session and pay again. In wither retail or residential, UrbanNashville is not responsible for any towing, booting, or ticketing fees. Please inquire if you would like to purchase a residential parking pass prior to arrival. Public parking is paid onsite upon arrival via a parking app

Other things to note
Please note: We are not responsible for pool rules set by the community. The community only allows 3 guests per apartment. The pool is open from dusk till dawn. 

→ This unit is ideal for 4 guests, but with the sofa bed can sleep 6 if needed. Note that the sofa bed is queen sized. We also have a limited number of cots available for rent. 
→ No Saturday arrival or departures allowed.  We typically will have a 2-night minimum on the weekends. Minimum night stays may fluctuate with certain events and holidays. 
→ Parking: Paid parking is available onsite. We can provide ONE parking pass for the residential section of the garage for $40/day. Residential parking guarantees one parking spot with in-and-out privileges. The second option is to park in the public section of the garage which typically starts at $40/day however WITHOUT in-and-out privileges and no guaranteed spot. *No in -and-out privileges means if you leave the parking garage and return, you will need to restart your parking session and pay again. In wither retail or residential, UrbanNashville is not responsible for any towing, booting, or ticketing fees. Please inquire if you would like to purchase a residential parking pass prior to arrival. Public parking is paid onsite upon arrival via a parking app. 
→ We are located on the 2nd floor of our building and are accessible via a full flight of stairs or a handy elevator. :) 
→ If this unit isn't available, we have other Pine Street Flats! 
→ Check-in is at 4 pm // Check out is at 10 am. If you're looking to check in early or check out late, we suggest booking the night before or after your arrival. Otherwise, to be considerate of other guests, we cannot guarantee that early check-in or late check-out request will be accommodated. Feel free to arrive anytime after 4 pm.
→  There are a dishwasher and ice maker. Laundry is in the unit. Towels & linen are provided (including linen & pillows for the sofa bed). Travel-sized toiletries, a hairdryer, iron, and ironing board are provided. A drip coffee maker and basic kitchenware are also provided. Guests are responsible to provide any additional amenities desired such as additional toilet paper.
→After placing your booking you will receive a text from our team with a link to sign a form to confirm you've reviewed our house rules and ensure the check-in process go smoothly. We will send access info one day prior to arrival, if booking same day, you may call our team as soon as you've booked. Please ensure your number on your Airbnb profile is up to date.
→ Our team is around 24/7 for any emergency that may arise.
→ The permit # can be found in the listing captions.
